class.name: SteamNotificationStore
class.brief_description: Trusted persistence adapter for notification keys and session ownership.
class.description: Inject the implementation through [member SteamPublisherSettings.notification_store]. Use durable storage that applies the operation key, fingerprint, target reservation, and ownership decisions across backend workers.

method.name: _claim_launch_opt_in
method.description: Atomically reserve notification registration for the exact verified app, account, and authoritative launch ID across backend workers. Return [constant OK] only for a new durable claim, [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] when it is already claimed, or an error if authorization or storage fails. Keep the claim after dispatch even when Steam does not confirm the response.

method.name: _claim
method.description: Atomically compare the app-scoped key and fingerprint, replay completed receipts, and claim a new write only when authorized. Update and remove claims also reserve the exact owned target against competing keys until settlement. An unresolved sent operation remains reserved for trusted reconciliation.

method.name: _commit
method.description: Atomically commit the exact claim and its provider ID. Record ownership on create, preserve it on update, and retire it on remove. Release the target reservation in the same transaction.

method.name: _owns_session
method.description: Returns whether the trusted backend currently owns this provider session for the configured app.

method.name: _release_unsent
method.description: Atomically releases the exact claim and its target reservation when Crimson reports that transport scheduling failed.

method.name: _release_unsent_launch_opt_in
method.description: Release the exact launch claim when Crimson confirms no Steam request was scheduled. Return true only after releasing the claim durably.

constants.constant: Create a new app-owned notification session.
Replace an owned session's participant state.
Remove an owned session and its notifications.
